assumptions: family, units, donor, residual and gates frozen before controller outcomes
metrics exact on the finite family
claims.name: Exact noncompensatory admission
claims.statement: For a frozen finite family with exact metrics, a residual is admissible exactly when all bindings pass and its full CRE20/R10/WSS95/sign/harm/absolute-WSS vector belongs to the registered conjunctive gate region.

assumptions: joint coverage includes residual selection, endpoints and units
claims.name: Simultaneous robust admission
not_claimed: V8 or V10 supplies such simultaneous inference
claims.statement: If a simultaneous 1-alpha confidence set covers the full target gate vector and admission requires the set to be contained in the gate region, false admission probability is at most alpha.

assumptions: same task, access, budget and authority contract
claims.name: Safe residual envelope embedding
not_claimed: every admitted residual dominates each review
claims.statement: A certificate-switched residual class contains the donor attainable set, executes exact donor on rejection or unbound evidence, and admits only gate-certified residuals on the joint-coverage event.

assumptions: at least two independently gated coordinates
claims.name: No ordinary compensatory scalar equivalence
not_claimed: impossibility under every bounded registered domain or lexicographic rule
claims.statement: On an unbounded or range-unregistered metric domain, no finite ordinary weighted linear score is sound and complete for the noncompensatory gate conjunction.

assumptions: at least seven admissible unobserved worlds
no restriction determines unobserved metric differences
claims.name: Finite-failure non-identification
claims.statement: Without a cross-world restriction, finite observed residual failures admit observationally identical extensions in which a new family fails or passes; universal u4 optimality and future success are both unidentified.

assumptions: donor class saturated over donor-measurable policies
same task, access, action and acquisition support, budget, cost, authority and world contract
candidate decision constant on donor fibres
claims.name: Donor-fibre embedding and separation
not_claimed: single u4 is saturated, Bayes-optimal or universally optimal
dominance under a mismatched cost, access, world or authority contract
claims.statement: A same-support, same-contract candidate constant on donor-state fibres belongs to a saturated donor-complete class. Valid strict same-contract outside-envelope separation requires new fibre-separating information/state, new acquisition support, or proof the donor class was unsaturated. A contract mismatch changes the comparison and cannot establish dominance under the original contract.

assumptions: the residual input is exactly the donor title-abstract input with deterministic title duplication
claims.name: Title emphasis is information-preserving
claims.statement: Title duplication is a deterministic transform of the existing title-abstract fields; it adds no raw information and cannot expand the acquired identity union.

claims.name: V10 gate reconstruction
claims.statement: V10 fails CRE20 and R10 magnitude and sign gates while passing mean WSS95, harm and absolute WSS95; exact u4 remains fallback.

global_forbidden_claims: source-general, domain-general, workflow-general or application-exact superiority
existence of a future positive residual family
new acquisition from a deterministic same-field transform
